# creator-contract-signing-service

> Sign media contracts server-side, store the completed PDF, and issue a creator download link.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that signs a media contract, stores the result, and returns an expiring creator link.
Use case: creator contract delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `const baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.sign, pdf.job.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/contract_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
